headline: Teen's Nonprofit Teaches 350 Children to Ride Bikes
meta_description: Jonathan Thai, 17, from Alpharetta, Georgia, founded a nonprofit that raised $30,000, donated 400 bikes, and taught 350 children to ride.
summary_short: A 17-year-old from Georgia turned his passion into action, creating a nonprofit that has already transformed hundreds of young lives through cycling.
body:
Jonathan Thai, a 17-year-old from Alpharetta, Georgia, has founded a nonprofit that raised $30,000 and donated 400 bikes to children in need.

Through his initiative, Thai has taught 350 children how to ride, opening doors to mobility, independence, and outdoor activity for young people who might otherwise lack access. The scale of his impact—from fundraising to direct instruction—reflects both his ambition and the community's response to his vision.

At an age when many are still figuring out their path, Thai has created a tangible model for youth-led social change, proving that meaningful community impact doesn't require waiting until adulthood.
